purpose: Painted concept sprites and wallpaper references for Claude to build native voxel furnishings. Not registered in the live game.
artStyle: Same inked hand-painted storybook gothic style as existing moon wardrobe, copper pan rail and pumpkin ottoman; walnut, brass/copper, plum/burgundy, amber glow.
angle: Front+left three-quarter view; vertical edges remain vertical. Wallpaper swatches are flat orthographic.
scaleNote: Individual concepts fill their allotted space independently; suggested world scale is semantic, not a pixel-to-unit conversion. Measure actual native model bodies before release.

sheets.layoutNote: Use referenceRectPx, not a uniform UV grid. Tall ornaments can cross a nominal row edge. Images are visual modelling references, not a runtime-ready sprite atlas.
